queries.scope: Identify first-party local land-registry/cadastral sources and safe anonymous parcel geometry.
queries.result: Official Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Revenue & Estate Department sources identify land-record computerization and Service Delivery Centers, and the KPLR appointment portal lists Swabi and Razar centers. The eFard/CLRMIS entry workflow searches using registered name, father’s name and CNIC after biometric verification; no identity-based lookup was attempted. No anonymous parcel-vector layer, safe geometry schema or point-to-polygon response was found. The WUP point’s relation to a specific revenue circle/mauza is unverified.
